docs.title: ROCK: Acquisition or Disposition of Shares of Another Corporation
docs.text:
Purchase of 74.8% stake in Alabang Commercial Corporation (ACC)

Rockwell Land Corporation (PSE: ROCK) executed today share purchase agreements (SPA) with Mr. Francisco M. Bayot, Jr. and other shareholders of ACC.

With the acquisition, ROCK will have the opportunity to expand its footprint in a prime location with long term redevelopment opportunities. The existing assets of ACC will add 137,000 sqm of gross leasable area to ROCK's existing retail and office portfolio, representing a 58% growth.

ROCK executed SPAs with Mr. Francisco M. Bayot, Jr. and other ACC Shareholders.

ACC is a domestic corporation that owns and operates Alabang Town Center, a shopping mall located in Muntinlupa City.

Total consideration of Php 21.6 Billion will be paid in 3 equal installments.

Arms-length negotiations

3 equal installment payments due on or before December 22, 2025, December 15, 2026 and December 15, 2027

Usual Conditions

58% increase in ROCKs gross leasable area.

docs.title: GSMI: Declaration of Cash Dividends
docs.text:
Declaration of Cash Dividends to Shareholders

Please be informed that at the meeting of the Board of Directors of Ginebra San Miguel Inc. (the "Board") held on April 30, 2026, the Board approved the declaration and payment of cash dividends on common shares to all shareholders of record as of May 19, 2026.

Unappropriated retained earnings of March 31, 2026.

The Stock and Transfer Book of the Company will be closed from May 20- 24, 2026. Please see attached SEC Form 17-C which we filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission today, April 30, 2026.
